findings.finding: कौशल बदलावों is an understandable but awkward noun compound. कौशल में प्रस्तावित बदलावों expresses the relationship more naturally and keeps the review explicitly about proposals.

observations: Reviewed all 15 values against English, context and live call sites. आपकी स्वीकृति addresses the operator politely. The singular एजेंट/टीम/कौशल match the tabs. बनाने का प्रस्ताव and प्रस्तावित बदलाव preserve operation and pending status; पुराना indicates stale. The update note preserves the product name and intended remedy.
समीक्षा करें is a respectful review instruction, not an approval command, and is included in each distinct accessible name. सभी दिखाएँ/कम दिखाएँ are complementary; the tooltip retains both facts.

execution.method: Node source-only assertions with the repository's FormatJS ICU parser and IntlMessageFormat
execution.actual: hi: 15 values/context keys, 16 ICU formatting cases, no manual bidi controls — PASS
execution.verified: CLDR one/other, invariant direct-form बदलाव is valid in both arms, count interpolation, both distinct three-arm review selects including label-in-name and name retention, show_all and tab_title arguments

limits: Prior evidence unavailable per brief; newly audited from current bytes, not reconstructed. No rendered fit, native/manual QA or release approval claimed.
